Manual entry

Every lead costs you a conversation

"DM 'INFO'" means each new lead needs you, or someone on your team, in the inbox. Lead flow can only grow as fast as your hours.

No first purchase

Most of your audience can't say yes

Plenty of people who watch your reels want to lead better but aren't ready for coaching. With nothing smaller to buy, they don't buy anything.

No capture

Reach that leaves no trace

5 of your last 7 reels went past 2k views. Unless they DM you or find the free guide on your website, viewers leave no email and no way to follow up.

Anyone not ready to DM you or book a call today usually leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Sound familiar?

Your team isn't the problem. The way it runs is.

  • Every question, decision and fire still ends up with you.
  • You've told them the standard. It slips the moment you look away.
  • Hard conversations get put off until they turn into bigger ones.
  • You're working more hours than anyone, and the business still waits on you.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

Why your team waits for you

How leaders accidentally train their people to bring every problem upstairs, and how to hand real ownership back.

Lead by standard, not by mood

Set a handful of clear non-negotiables so everyone knows what "good" looks like without asking.

The accountability conversation

How to address a missed standard directly, without damaging trust or waiting until you're angry.

One weekly rhythm that keeps everyone aligned

A simple meeting structure that surfaces problems early and keeps the team pointed the same way.

Dare enough to make the hard call

How to make the decisions you've been sitting on, faster, and lead your team through them.
